text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Satono Diamond is first across the
finish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: She looks like she's in great shape to me!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She ran so beautifully! She just kept
charging
straight ahead with supreme
focus...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's like she didn't let anything faze her
or lead her
astray. I'm spellbound...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. The very result I was expecting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Had she faltered here, it would have
meant she
wasn't fit to challenge me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...This is it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is my style of running!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Everything felt perfectly natural
today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's a huge relief to know that you didn't
see any
issues!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she's necessarily gotten a
lot stronger, but I tell her about the
improvement in
the power of her strides
and her core stability.
choice_data_list: There was real power in your strides!
There was real power in your strides.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Really? But I wasn't focused on that at
all while I
was running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that's she regained her form, I
imagine the
fruits of her training are
starting to emerge
naturally.
choice_data_list: It's become second nature in your ...
It's become a natural part of your...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! Then it should be possible
for me to
build up my physical strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It may even be possible for me to race
overseas
someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's possible her training might once
again have a negative influence on her
running, but I don't
think there's
anything to worry about anymore.
choice_data_list: Let's find an approach that works ...
Let's find a method that works for...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She now understands the true essence of
her style, so we should be able to devise
a method
that best complements her
development.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure it will work out.
I won't lose
my way
again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to focus on what's in front of
me and
run for my desires!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I finally have my opportunity
to race
McQueen! And not to mention
Kita!
choice_data_list: Keep up that momentum for the Tenn...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've dreamed of this for so long! And
now it's
finally becoming reality...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And if I can win, it will serve as proof
that I'm
talented enough to be an
illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My role model and my long-time rival...
To think
I'd have the opportunity to
compete against them
both.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepared to put everything on the
line for this!
